scope: workbench-managed JSON, JSONL/NDJSON and ownership sidecars plus consumed external state

entries.schema: schema 1: unknown maintenance outcome, original claim bytes and exact receipt, observed authority/source hash and counts, timestamp; no password, master key or recovered content
entries.writePrimitive: explicit cold source owner; create-only wx 0600 file, sync and native directory flush, strict readback before exact claim retirement
entries.corruption: partial or changed observations are retained as inert evidence; never consulted as execution, completion, activation or boot authority
entries.capacity: 64KiB per observation; manual retention, no automatic deletion or bounded aggregate count
entries.recovery: doctor --recover-work-data-source verifies the source twice without replay; errors before unlink preserve the pending claim, errors after unlink retain its durable original bytes in the observation
entries.exemptionReason: source-external diagnostic of an unknown operation requires cross-file claim/owner proof; not a defaulting JSON business store

entries.schema: schema 1: exact job, operation, source authority, durable backup and monotonically advanced candidate phase
entries.writePrimitive: private issued receipt and serialized transition; wx stage, file sync, native directory flush, rename and identity/hash readback
entries.corruption: unknown or interrupted stage blocks startup; no repair, quarantine or overwrite of an unexplained intent
entries.capacity: one pending intent; 32KiB bounded read; stages are retained on uncertainty
entries.cache: normal writers retain private issued receipts; explicit read-selected proof binds exact original bytes/hash/size/dev/ino and source owner without becoming an issued write receipt
entries.recovery: normal boot refuses pending state; doctor --recover-work-data-intent may retire an exact complete enable/disable intent only after a trusted cold host revalidates its existing published result/backup and two complete source profiles inside the matching owned claim mutation gate; absent-result C10 remains unknown
entries.exemptionReason: multi-file generation/backup/native ownership protocol cannot use a single-file defaulting JSON lifecycle

entries.schema: schema 1: job, operation, observed source/current authorities, native backup identity/hash and optional separate-target restore metadata
entries.writePrimitive: exact exclusive cold owner; wx stage, file sync, native directory flush, rename and private receipt verification
entries.corruption: unknown stage or invalid record refuses; historical different-authority record is not current completion authority
entries.capacity: one latest result; 16KiB bounded read; no password or recovered content
entries.cache: none for reads; private issued receipts for the writing process only
entries.recovery: current reads separately authenticate authority and actual backup bytes/identity; snapshot decoding preserves raw historical metadata without reading its old external backup path
entries.exemptionReason: cross-file durable backup and active-generation proof require a dedicated transaction; completion metadata never selects a root

entries.schema: schema 1: exact eight keys (kind restored-boot-root, canonical target, target dev/ino, target authority summary, source result id/sha256, createdAt); no password, master key, activation receipt or user content
entries.writePrimitive: independent wx 0600 stage file, file sync, native directory flush, rename and strict single-link sha256/dev/ino readback; the record codec is owned by 00-boot; CAS by the exact previous receipt; byte-identical content is never rewritten
entries.corruption: a read never repairs, rewrites or deletes a bad or stage-pending record: normal boot falls back to the default root; a target alias, dev/ino mismatch or missing genN pointer is ignored
entries.capacity: one record; 16KiB bounded read; no user content
entries.cache: none: 00-boot reads it once per process before the first data-root resolution
entries.recovery: doctor --clear-boot-root removes only the exact inspected sha/dev/ino receipt through the maintenance/test path; the next boot then uses the default root; a hard crash stage (.boot-root-v1.stage-*) requires owner-verified manual cleanup
entries.exemptionReason: long-lived serving-root preference, never authority: manifest and ownership bind still fail closed, and TEMP activation is never promoted

entries.schema: object / schema 1: consumer id, label, tokenHash, fixed workspace identity, tool/resource grants, revision, enabled and optional auditSessionId; no reusable plaintext token
entries.writePrimitive: DurableJsonStore strictRead; runKeyedChain serializes administration; durable write precedes successful setup/revoke response
entries.corruption: missing means empty initial registry; malformed/schema-invalid/shape-invalid or unreadable existing state throws without default reset or silent authorization
entries.capacity: 32 consumer rows, seven fixed file-tool grants and two safe-summary resource grants per row; create prunes disabled rows; label <=100 chars
entries.cache: shared lifecycle process cache and write-through; active revoking set blocks access immediately before persistence
entries.recovery: restart reads durable registry; missing registry requires deliberate new setup; issued plaintext token is not recoverable from hashes; existing audit thread uses the original session/checkpoint journal
entries.exemptionReason: authorization registry uses the existing strict durable lifecycle; failed persistence is not a successful durable revocation

entries.schema: object / schema 1: exact 127.0.0.1 host, listening port and random host instanceId; no management token or consumer secret
entries.writePrimitive: atomicWriteJson with mode 0600 when host begins listening
entries.corruption: relay rejects missing, symlink, oversized, unparsable or invalid discovery; no fallback to runtime.json or a remote host
entries.capacity: one current host discovery object; relay read cap 4096 bytes
entries.cache: read fresh by relay discovery; no persistent connection authority in this file
entries.recovery: actual host listen atomically replaces stale discovery; live instance validation refuses stale/restarted connection state
entries.exemptionReason: nonsecret regenerable runtime locator, not consumer authorization or secret storage
